title: The “Dad, My Phone Broke” Text Meets Pops
description:
“Dad, my phone broke” can be a scam. Call the family number you already know before sending money.
Cartoon dramatization of official scam warnings, not a recorded case. Don't copy Pops's replies; verify separately.
Sources:
ACMA: https://www.acma.gov.au/articles/2024-01/scam-alert-re-emergence-hi-mum-scam
